name: waga-mom
source:
Story
Akira is just an ordinary young woman.
Her parents are alive and well. She has good friends she can count on.
Her mother is a bit of a helicopter mom — annoying, sure, but not a big deal.
She prefers a quiet life. Just your average, everyday person.

Whether Akira's life changes or stays the same — that's up to you.

Game system
This is a choice-based visual novel.
Follow Akira's daily life and choose from options that appear along the way.
Your choices will lead to one of seven possible endings.

Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5070070/
